evidence.notes: Named Map<String,Object> bind with SYSTEM_MODE returns the exact persisted Account count in deployable Apex test context.

source.content: @isTest private class DataDatabaseQueryBindsSystemModeRuntimeTest { @isTest static void countQueryWithBindsRunsInSystemMode() { insert new List<Account>{new Account(Name = 'Bind Target'), new Account(Name = 'Bind Other')}; Map<String,Object> binds = new Map<String,Object>{'wantedName' => 'Bind Target'}; Integer matching = Database.countQueryWithBinds('SELECT COUNT() FROM Account WHERE Name = :wantedName', binds, AccessLevel.SYSTEM_MODE); System.assertEquals(1, matching); } }
